items.exampleEn: Most small scars fade with time.

items.sentenceEn: Our best player is injured, so he will miss the final game.

items.audioEn: Don't open that email; it might infect your computer with a virus.

items.questionZh: 說話者提醒對方不要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Arteries carry blood away from the heart to the rest of the body.
items.sentenceZh: 動脈把血液從心臟送往全身各處。

items.sentenceEn: He laughed so hard that his ribs hurt.

items.stemEn: Many people say their ____ to their phones makes it hard to sleep.
items.stemZh: 很多人說，他們對手機上癮，讓他們很難入睡。

items.stemEn: In chess, one careless move can be ____ to your whole game.
items.stemZh: 在西洋棋中，一步粗心的棋可能讓整盤棋全盤皆輸。

items.passageEn: Our football team had a difficult season. In the first month, our captain was injured during practice and had to rest for six weeks. The coach called it a fatal blow to our hopes, but we kept going. Then a computer virus infected the club's system, and we lost all our training videos. Still, things got better. A local company gave the club a large injection of money, so we bought new equipment. Our captain came back with a small scar on his knee and a new addiction to stretching. Even with a sore rib, our goalkeeper played the whole final, and we won! Afterwards, we were all starving and shared three huge pizzas.
items.passageZh: 我們足球隊這一季過得很辛苦。第一個月，隊長在練習時受傷，必須休息六週。教練說這對我們的希望是致命一擊，但我們還是繼續努力。接著，一種電腦病毒感染了球隊的系統，我們失去了所有訓練影片。不過，情況漸漸好轉。一家當地公司給球隊注入了一大筆資金，我們因此買了新裝備。隊長回來時膝蓋多了一道小疤痕，還迷上了伸展運動。就算肋骨痠痛，我們的守門員還是踢完了整場決賽，而且我們贏了！賽後大家都餓壞了，一起分了三個大披薩。

questions.questionZh: 球隊為什麼能買新裝備？
options: 球員們辦了義賣籌到錢
教練自己出錢買給大家
一家當地公司給了一大筆錢

items.instructionZh: 用 scar 造一個句子，說說你或某樣東西上的一道疤痕或痕跡怎麼來的。
referenceEn: I have a small scar on my hand from a cooking accident.
My old guitar has a scar on the back from a bad fall.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 scar（例如 a scar on my hand）
